288/288 sampled RUST leaf values are bit-identical to the champion's at {'jrules_dose': 0.0, 'jrules_mask': 27} (the dose gate holds with the mask moved). leaf_hash(dose-0 + MOVED mask) = 92ac0da996e1b37b != champion a36d2e15a3b3d71d: _LEAF_HASH_EXCLUDE_IF_DEFAULT drops a field only while it holds its DEFAULT value, so the moved mask stays in the hashed dict even though the dose gate makes the leaf VALUES bit-identical. Consequence for the chain: a cell whose dose was accidentally zeroed would still PASS `cand_hash_moves` -- the hash gate cannot catch it, and `parse_doses`' refusal of dose 0.0 is the gate that does.
